title: 5. User observability
description: Active users and sessions, login tracking, monthly user growth, top token consumers, session time, and usage spikes.

options.content: 1. Infrastructure2. Network3. AI4. Data5. User6. Cost & Usage7. Safety & Security

panels.title: Active users

targets.expr: count(count by (user_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | user_id != "" [5m])))

panels.description: Distinct `user_id` values in telemetry logs over the last 5 minutes (headline stat, last value). Source: Loki `telemetry_event`.

panels.title: Active sessions

targets.expr: count(count by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | session_id != "" [5m])))

panels.description: Distinct `session_id` values in telemetry logs over the last 5 minutes (headline stat, last value). Source: Loki `telemetry_event`.

panels.title: Logins (24h)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="login_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" [24h])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Count of `login_event` logs in 24h — emitted when a new session starts (turn 1).

panels.title: Active users (24h)

targets.expr: count(count by (user_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | user_id != "" [24h])))

panels.description: Distinct `user_id` values with at least one `telemetry_event` in 24h.

panels.title: Monthly active users (30d)

targets.expr: count(count by (user_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="login_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | user_id != "" [30d])))

panels.description: Distinct users with a `login_event` in the last 30 days — monthly active user (MAU) proxy.

panels.title: LLM usage spike (15m vs prev 15m)

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [15m])) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [30m])) - sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [15m])) or vector(1)) - 1) * 100

panels.description: Percent change in total tokens: last 15m vs the prior 15m window (computed as [15m] ÷ ([30m] − [15m])). High values indicate sudden platform-wide LLM usage growth.

panels.title: Login & user growth
Login track

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="login_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Login/session-start events per 5m bucket from `login_event` logs.

panels.title: Daily active users (24h)

targets.expr: count(count by (user_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="login_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" [24h])))

panels.description: Distinct users with a `login_event` in the last 24h (stat with sparkline).

panels.title: Active users by department (24h)

targets.expr: sort_desc(count by (department) (count by (user_id, department) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | user_id != "" | department != "" [24h]))))

panels.description: Distinct active users per `department` in the last 24h — ranked horizontal bars. The department filter is intentionally ignored so all departments are visible.
Login activity and department-level user counts

panels.title: Token consumption by user
Top 10 users — tokens (24h)

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [24h])))

panels.description: Users ranked by sum of `total_tokens` over 24h — who is consuming the most tokens.

panels.title: Top 10 users — token rate (5m)

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [5m])))

panels.description: Instant bar chart — top 10 users by tokens consumed in the last 5m.

panels.title: Top 10 users — cost (24h)

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd [24h])))

panels.description: Heaviest spenders by USD cost over 24h (`cost_usd`).

panels.title: Tokens per session (5m)

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [5m])) / (count(count by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | session_id != "" [5m]))) or vector(1))

panels.description: Total tokens divided by active sessions — per-session token intensity.
Heaviest token consumers and per-session token intensity

panels.title: Session-level usage
Top 10 users — session time (6h)

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap session_time_ms [6h])))

panels.description: Users ranked by summed `session_time_ms` — wall-clock time spent in sessions (reading, typing, waiting), not per-request API latency.

panels.title: Top users by tokens (6h)

targets.expr: topk(50, sum by (user_id, department) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [6h])))

panels.description: Table of top 50 users by total tokens in 6h, with department.

panels.title: Session time by user (top 10, 5m)

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap session_time_ms [5m])))

panels.description: Instant bar chart — top 10 users by summed `session_time_ms` in the last 5m.

panels.title: Avg turns per session (1h)

targets.expr: avg(max_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap turn_number [1h]))

panels.description: Average maximum turn number per session — conversation depth.

panels.title: Session duration p95

targets.expr: max(quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap session_time_ms [5m]))

panels.description: 95th-percentile wall-clock session time (`session_time_ms`).
Session duration, turn depth, and per-user token tables

panels.title: Usage spikes
Token volume — spike detector (5m buckets)

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [5m]))

sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [1h])) / 12

panels.description: Total token volume per 5m vs 1h average per 5m bucket — visual spike detection for LLM usage.

panels.title: Top 10 users — spike ratio (15m vs prev 15m)

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [15m]))) / (  sum by (user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [30m]))   - sum by (user_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_type="telemetry_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region" | model_provider=~"$provider" | model_name=~"$model" | unwrap total_tokens [15m]))   or on(user_id) vector(1)))

panels.description: Per-user ratio: tokens in last 15m ÷ tokens in the previous 15m (30m window minus last 15m). Values above ~1.5 mean usage in the last 15m exceeds the prior 15m baseline.

panels.title: Recent login events

targets.expr: {service_name=~".+"} | event_type="login_event" | department=~"$department" | region=~"$region"

panels.description: Live stream of `login_event` logs with user, session, department, and auth method.
Sudden usage spikes and recent login audit
